## 7. Rules that never bend
- No gate waits on the clock; nothing expires. Nothing punishes absence; no fake scarcity; no pay-to-skip.
- Every addition changes what the player does or sees.
- Words a 7 year old understands; no emoji; Arabic-ready text.
- Old saves always load. Economy changes come with sims before and after.
